problem: 24 MP 10-bit HEIF was refused because retained-output cap was incorrectly applied to three estimated working-plane equivalents.
production_fix: Retained RGBA remains capped at 512 MiB. Before codec execution, managed requests admit retained output plus two estimated native planes, including larger encoded crop dimensions. Output reservation is transferred into the retained pixel owner. Native plugin allocations remain estimated, not exhaustively measured.
regression: 64x48 fixture encoded as 64x64: output 24576 bytes, working peak 90112 bytes. Exact budget succeeds and retains 24576; one byte less refuses and releases all credit.

independent_comparison.boundary: Different u16 expansion/color-conversion rounding; bounded agreement, not byte-identical decoder or photographic color fidelity.

transport: All 384000000 native float payload bytes hashed before/after swap using BLAKE3-backed ObjectPayloadHasher; metadata/extent exact, managed pressure refusal and retry, root/queue zero. Full source uploaded to Metal; SDR output 128x96 and HDR output 128x64 exact before/after restore. This is not 6000x4000 GPU readback.
timing_boundary: Optimized debug/test build, shared machine load, single observations; not a controlled release benchmark or broad speed qualification. Large HEIF loading still needs optimization.
